statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the only publicly discoverable route. No internal routes, links, sitemap, or form flow were discoverable.

page.notes: The only reachable public route server-renders framework scaffolding and a logo, then remains visually empty.

The service exposes no route, control, or state change at all; the expected interactive form experience is replaced by a static blank shell with no continuity cue.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to the sole reachable, non-interactive route.

paths.description: Public landing/entry route and only discoverable template. Tested as the expected gateway to the government form service; no other internal routes, links, sitemap entries, manifest shortcuts, or flows were available. Uncovered: shared/private form URLs requiring an undisclosed identifier.

findings.summary: No user-preference dark theme
findings.evidence: The dark emulation remains the same white canvas and color-scheme computes to normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme surface/foreground tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The landing page is an unexplained blank canvas
findings.evidence: Only the Kemenkes logo renders; there is no heading, explanatory copy, form list, or primary action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a clear page heading, explain how to access or create a form, and expose the primary next action or a useful empty state.

findings.summary: No form journey can start
findings.evidence: The DOM has zero links, forms, buttons, and inputs, so the advertised form service has no reachable flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a crawlable, operable route into the primary form journey, or clearly explain that a shared form URL is required and how to obtain one.

findings.summary: The empty state offers no status or recovery
findings.evidence: There is no loading, empty, error, retry, help, or back state on the blank page.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement explicit loading/error/empty states with retry and help actions, announced accessibly.

findings.summary: LCP is borderline for an almost empty page
findings.evidence: The trace measured LCP at 2.59 s while Lighthouse measured 2.2 s; the variance is notable given the page contains only a logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document/resource latency and prioritize the actual LCP asset; verify under throttled repeat runs.

findings.summary: The blank route ships avoidable JavaScript
findings.evidence: Nine scripts transfer 141.7 KB and Lighthouse identifies 20 KB of unused JavaScript for a page with no interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route-only dependencies and avoid hydrating UI libraries until an actual form surface is needed.

findings.summary: The document has no main landmark or heading
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails landmark-one-main, and DOM inspection finds no main or h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and add a descriptive h1 with a logical landmark/heading structure.

findings.summary: The viewport prevents user zoom
findings.evidence: The viewport uses maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse flags this as inaccessible to low-vision users.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable=no; retain width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

findings.summary: Metadata does not describe a specific task
findings.evidence: Title and description repeat the generic product name verbatim.
findings.suggestedFix: Write a concise, unique description of the landing page purpose and expected next action.

findings.summary: The public route has no crawlable navigation and blocks scaling
findings.evidence: No anchors exist, robots.txt is missing, and the viewport prevents scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add real href navigation to useful public/form routes, allow zoom, and publish an intentional robots policy.

findings.summary: Canonical and crawl-policy signals are missing
findings.evidence: No canonical link is present, and robots.txt and sitemap.xml both return 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical metadata plus intentional robots.txt and sitemap.xml resources for public routes.

findings.summary: Core security headers are absent
findings.evidence: The HTTPS response lacks CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive CSP, HSTS after HTTPS readiness, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff at the origin or edge.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced framing and privacy policies are absent
findings.evidence: No frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy is sent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options fallback), a strict Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core purpose is absent with and without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Both rendered and crawler screenshots lack content or controls; raw HTML provides only metadata/logo scaffolding.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render a meaningful heading, explanation, and crawlable recovery/action path before client enhancement.

findings.summary: The form application has no install or offline fallback
findings.evidence: No manifest or controlling service worker is present.
findings.suggestedFix: If this service is intended as an app, add a manifest and a minimal offline/error fallback for previously opened forms.

findings.summary: A no-form/failure state collapses to a blank shell
findings.evidence: The reachable route supplies no explanation or retry path when no form content exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Render actionable empty and failure states, including retry, support, and safe navigation.

findings.summary: The document language is incorrect
findings.evidence: An Indonesian government service declares lang="en".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare the actual page language, likely lang="id", and set language per localized route/content.

findings.summary: A 100 px logo transfers 92 KB
findings.evidence: The SVG is the largest resource at 92,466 bytes despite rendering at 100 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Optimize the SVG markup and path precision; compare visually and cache the minimized asset immutably.

findings.summary: The expected interactive experience has no state continuity
findings.evidence: A service called “Form” exposes no route, control, or state change; users see only an inert blank shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the primary interaction first, then use progressive View Transitions for meaningful route or state continuity while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: The page provides no orientation or next-step cue
findings.evidence: There is no heading, navigation, primary action, focus target, or visual cue beyond the logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a clear heading and primary path, then preserve focus and visibly cue destination/state changes.
